name: native-select
title: Native select
description: The browser select, styled. Best on mobile and for long simple lists.
a11y: A real select element: native keyboard, typeahead and mobile pickers.
Inside a Field it is labelled and described automatically.

props.name: size
props.description: `md` (default), `sm` for dense layouts or `lg` for prominent forms. Heights match Button and the other form controls at each size.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the control invalid (`aria-invalid`). A surrounding Field sets this from its `error`.

usage: import {Field, NativeSelect} from '@monoline/react';
